bug.title: Database access errors have no closed ownership and recovery claim
bug.summary: Database access errors are recorded without reading or mutating any real user database; ownership, migration, and recovery evidence remain open.

steps: Use a temporary fixture to model the reported access error.
Do not open, enumerate, copy, or mutate a real user database.
reproduction.observed: Database ownership and current runtime impact are unknown in this source-only node.

confirmed_facts.statement: The database-access issue is explicitly registered as an independent v0.8.3 requirement, change, and bug tuple.

hypotheses.statement: A runtime ownership or migration boundary may cause the reported access error; the current target has not been run.
